description: S13 contract v7 GT derivation rule thresholds (decision ledger S13_contract_v7_decision_log.md V7-R1 + sections 3.7-3.8, rules doc S13_v7_risk_factor_rules.md v2.4). FROZEN (2026-10-12, Stage C): the five calibration slots are final from the S13 train-only calibration sweep (S13_v7_calibration_report.md) - firing.base_m = 2.0, crossing_gate.lateral_thr_mps = 0.8 (speed threshold of the v2.4 crossing arrival test; thr calibration closed), object_near.radius_m = 5.5, braking.y_brake_m = 1.185, stationary_obstacle.y_st_m = 3.0 (extension scan 3.5/4.0 rejected: 3.5 breaks the 25% stationary-alarm guardrail with poor marginal recovery of v6 misses); firing assumption single (base split not supported by data). Structure changes from v4/v6 rules: pool regrouped into vru/vehicle/static with per-class cone-range override (bicycle/motorcycle keep 45 m); corridor d_risk_* replaced by the firing engine (buffer = base + deterministic support-function projection h(theta_gap) of the annotation box onto the gap direction; firing iff min over 13 CV samples of (d_k - h_k) < base, d_k = 0 samples fire directly); since rules v2.4 both crossing factors use an arrival-time test decoupled from firing - v_toward (in-band |v_lat|, out-of-band -sign(y_c)*v_lat) > lateral_thr_mps AND t_arrive <= t_arrive_max_s, where t_arrive = (|y_c| - band_half_width_m) / v_toward (0 when the center is already in-band) - and the firing engine feeds the yield union only; the in-path condition of braking/stationary widens from the fixed 1.185 m band to calibrated lateral half-widths Y_brake < Y_st; congestion is removed (starved) and object_near added (instantaneous spatial evidence, all classes). Units: distances meters, angles degrees, times seconds, speeds m/s.
